Cross-checked sitemap-header.xml (53 header/footer nav URLs) - same set of category slugs, no furniture slug. Conclusion: Good Earth is a premium Indian lifestyle brand specializing in tableware, home textiles, decor, bath & fragrance, and apparel/jewellery - it does not carry a furniture line on goodearth.in. This is a genuine, thoroughly-inspected absence, not a missed department.
